ordering: task IDs sorted; repetition 1..3; left rotate four-arm order by (task_index + repetition - 1) mod 4

selection_rule.unit: task; average three repetitions before equal weighting
selection_rule.eligible: all planned evidence complete; observed success rate at least baseline; lower mean input tokens AND lower mean Agent duration
selection_rule.if_none_eligible: retain baseline; report no qualifying improvement
selection_rule.combined_modules: require a separate preregistered development comparison before adoption
selection_rule.interpretation: exploratory selection, not proof of success-rate noninferiority

holdout.rule: freeze one final configuration before running; no tuning or replacement based on outcomes

long_context: two synthetic mechanism fixtures remain separate from repair-effect estimates
